title: epan: Remove new proto tree API
description:
Remove experimental new API.

Fix netfilter dissector to compile with normal proto tree API.

Fixes #17774.

commits_data.title: epan: Remove new proto tree API
commits_data.message:
epan: Remove new proto tree API

Remove experimental new API.

Fix Netlink dissector to compile with normal proto tree API.

Closes #17774.
